GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down 6th 4 Lengths 800m Under Pressure 8th 8 Lengths home turn 9th Middle Of Track no run on Straight # poor run
Jumped okay, not bustled early & Settled Down 8 Lengths on fence, railed to 6 Lengths turning, Made Some Ground close to rail in Straight # never a factor
Jumped awkwardly & Settled Down 4.5 Lengths Two Wide , little change to 4 Lengths Two Wide turning, Hooked Out Four Wide Straightening Up and Made Some Ground to the line # battled on fairly

Jumped only fairly & Settled Down Mid Field 5 Lengths on fence, crowded and Lost Ground 800m, Drifted Back to 9 Lengths turning, improved a couple of lengths in straight. [Stewards: Post-race vet exam did not reveal any abnormalities.] # never a factor
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Appraoching the 800m was steadied when tightened for room.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay, Eased & Settled Down 8 Lengths 3 Wide , Drifted Back to 10 Lengths Two Wide turning, hooked widest at the 300m, Checked 250m then Made Ground down the outside in Straight # back/ran on fairly
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Near the 250m was checked and carried wider when a runner was taken out.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down 5.5 Lengths 3 Wide , Drifted Back to 7 Lengths Two Wide turning, shifetd wider Straightening Up and Made Some Ground in straight. (Visors OFF FIRST TIME) # never a factor
Jumped Ok , Hard Ridden Four Wide to get on Leaders heels but held Wide .5 Lengths 1000m, Hard Ridden soon after Straightening Up and was only one paced last 200m # tough run/tired
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced three-wide and without cover throughout the event.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Bit Slow Out Straight Out The Back Settled Down 2nd last 11 Lengths off leader/winner Ridden Along x 600m, clear run home Kept Finding Closest on line - # finished off ok
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Near the 1100m shifted out off heels.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Straight Out The Back 13 Lengths Held Together well back to Straightening Up hence had too much to do ! Kept Finding Closest on line, Sound (b/off v/1st) # got too far back
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: From the outside barrier was shifted behind runners in the early stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Drifted Back Settled Down Off Mid-Field 3 Wide with a trail 7 Lengths Under Pressure x Turn Just Kept Going One Pace - # Just Held Ground
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rdr reported the gelding did not close off the race as expected in the home straight and, in his view, may be looking for races over further distance. A post-race vet exam revealed no abnormalities.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Little Slow Out Not Bustled Settled Down Off Mid-Field 7 Lengths Two Wide with cover To The Turn home in between runners to 200 Kept Finding Closest on line, Need To See Again - # not clrst path
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Near the 350m, when initially taken outwards, then shifted out and made contact with another runner.
